title: A member-created Space and a seeded Space are born through the same two steps

source.ref: Seeders analysis 2026-10-21, follow-up to LIVE-1200; the owner approved moving the bundles test pin.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. LIVE-1200 put the shared birth in lib/spaces/provision-core.ts and moved only the seeder onto it, because lib/pricing/bundles.test.ts pinned provision.ts source text. With the owner's ruling to move the pin, createSpace now takes its Focus, tool defaults, directory kind and preset from spaceBirthConfig and finishes with finishSpaceBirth, so the two roads cannot drift again. The pins read provision-core.ts and one new pin asserts the action goes through it. The redirect literal that PROG-R9 and LIVE-901 probe is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/provision.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/spaceBirthConfig\(type,/.test(a))bad.push('createSpace does not use spaceBirthConfig');if(!/finishSpaceBirth\(spaceId, type, birth\)/.test(a))bad.push('createSpace does not use finishSpaceBirth');if(/setSpaceBundle/.test(a))bad.push('createSpace applies a bundle by hand again');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1210: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when createSpace grows its own birth steps again.
